title: Sindh Repeal of Police Order 2002 And Revival of The Police Act 1861 Ordinance 2011

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Repeal of Police Order 2002 And Revival of The Police Act 1861 Ordinance 2011
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE VI OF 2011
ORDINANCE VI OF 2011
SINDH (REPEAL OF POLICE ORDER, 2002 AND
REVIVAL OF THE POLICE ACT, 1861)
ORDINANCE, 2011
An Ordinance to repeal the Police Order, 2002
(Chief
Executive's Order No.22 of 2002) and revive the
Police Act, 1861 (Act No.V
of 1861)
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I,
9th July, 2011]
No. S.LEGIS:1(6)/2011, dated 9-7-2011.--The following Ordinance made by
the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general
information:--
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to
repeal the Police Order, 2002 (Chief Executive's Order No.22 of 2002) and
revive the Police Act, 1861 (Act No.V of 1861), in
the manner hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the Provincial Assembly is
not in session and the Governor is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now,
therefore, in exercise
of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of
Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973, the
Governor is pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This
Ordinance may be called the Sindh (Repeal of the
Police Order, 2002 and Revival of the Police Act, 1861) Ordinance, 2011.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

No. S.LEGIS:1(6)/2011, dated 9-7-2011.--The following Ordinance made by

information:--
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to
repeal the Police Order, 2002 (Chief Executive's Order No.22 of 2002) and

the manner hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the Provincial Assembly is

Now,
therefore, in exercise
of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of
Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973, the
Governor is pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:--
4. Saving.--Notwithstanding the repeal
of the Police Order, 2002 (Chief Executive's Order No.22 of 2002), all orders
made (including rules, bye-laws, regulations and notifications and other legal
instruments), proceedings taken, appointments made, acts done by any authority
or any person, which were made, taken or done, or purported to have been made,
taken or done thereunder, between the 13th day of
August, 2002 and the date on which this Ordinance comes into force (both days
inclusive), shall continue to remain in force, until altered, repealed or
amended by the Chief Minister or any authority or officer, authorized by him.
